title: Eddie Langlois today and the Slim and Eddie stage act
summary: Eddie Langlois lives in Slidell; people thought he was Slim's son. They ended shows with Eddie on Slim's shoulders.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: You seem to have a pretty successful life. I was trying to get back to Slim once, on one point, the, once you got, you had the band, you got the band together, you said Eddie Lang was in the band?
Yeah, he lives in Slidell now.
Yeah, I don't know, I think he went to California. I've tried to find him.

No, he's there unless he went in the last two or three months. He called me up, he had made a trip overseas with me, they told me, money water. He works for Camel Funer Home there in Slidell, that's where he can reach him. Camel? Camel? Camel suit, right, Camel suit. Oh, okay. Funer home. That's why you reach him there. But he called me about maybe a month and a half ago and said, just came overseas, it's only sure that the Murray Warden somebody, he calls someone.
Okay, yeah, somebody told me about something like that.
Yeah, but if you want a contract, you can make a place, a place to call, the Camel Fuel Home, and they can always give you his phone number. See, I don't have his phone number.

Okay, yeah, that's, that, that was it, somebody told me he went to California, that was it, the company he was booking was in California. Probably so, probably so. I think they probably thought he went out there to take care of some business or something.

He knows, he knows, he knows a lot about Slim because they, they, they, they were, they weren't, they weren't, they weren't. In fact, the people thought, thought that Eddie was his son. Eddie was named Eddie. Wasn't he short? He was short, yeah, real small, you see. And he was named Eddie, and of course, Giptar Slim was named Eddie. So they, they all would call Eddie, Eddie Jr. had to live in there, but they weren't thinking at all. So when Slim left us, we still drew the same crowd with him because people come by to see this, I'm going to see get to our Slim side, you see. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.

Mm-hm. Mm-hm. just before Slim would end his last number, and Eddie would go back and they would do a ballad and guitar together. You know, little Eddie would get on his shoulders and they'd get out on tables and that was the last number that he did, he said. He used to set the house up, man. He used to draw some crowd. He must have been popular with the ladies. He was popular. They both were popular. They both were popular.
